title: gentiana clusii subsp. alpina
intro: Gentiana clusii subsp. alpina, commonly known as alpine gentian, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the family Gentianaceae. It has been traditionally used to treat various health issues, including digestive problems and inflammation, due to its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of alpine gentian include its antiseptic, anti-inflammatory, and carminative properties, which help in soothing digestive issues and reducing inflammation. The bioactive constituents of Gentiana clusii subsp. alpina include gentiopicroside and gentianine, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
